name: What factors affect the total cost of installing bathroom wall tile?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the total cost of installing bathroom wall tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile material, wall preparation, and layout complexity are the primary cost drivers. Ceramic subway tile is generally the most budget-friendly, while natural stone, marble, and glass tiles require specialized blades, premium thin-sets, and slower cutting speeds. If demo reveals rotted studs or old plumbing leaks, repairing the rough carpentry and installing new cement board adds labor. Built-in elements like recessed shower niches, decorative accent borders, and uneven wall surfaces that require shimming will also increase overall installation labor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the tile material, the condition of the wall framing, required waterproofing repairs, and complex details like shower niches or intricate mosaic patterns.
